name: Andean Precious Metals Corp.
summary: Andean Precious Metals Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and processing of mineral resource properties in the United States. The company primarily explores for gold and silver deposits. It holds 100% interest in San Bartolomé project in Bolivia; and the Soledad Mountain mine and heap leach located in Kern County, California. The company is based in Toronto, Canada. Andean Precious Metals Corp. operates as a subsidiary of PMB Partners LP.
